learnings.insight: Desktop Chromium rarely exposes navigator.canShare({files}); Share visibility ACs need page.addInitScript mocks of canShare/share. Without mocks, success chrome correctly shows Downloaded + Dismiss only — that is AC-NS-1 negative evidence, not a missing button bug.
learnings.action: When smoking Web Share file flows in Playwright, mock canShare/share; treat native desktop Share=0 after export as the unsupported partition.

learnings.insight: Counting page-wide [role=alert] after AbortError can false-positive; scope alerts to [data-climb-transport] and assert text. Isolated probe showed 0 transport alerts after abort while a broad locator briefly reported an empty alert.
learnings.action: For AC-NS-5, assert transport-scoped alert count/text and that success+Share remain — do not fail on unrelated empty role=alert nodes.
